Q5735.reason: Only a defendant may remove; a plaintiff-initiated removal is a procedural defect, and a timely remand motion requires the whole case to go back.

Q5750.reason: Screen-reading difficulty from common age-related visual impairment is a real access barrier, and the claim that under 30% of over-65s have internet access is not true.

Q5130.reason: Carotid pulsation does not vary with posture, while earlobe waggling, hepatojugular reflux, and obliteration by root-of-neck pressure are jugular venous signs.
